title: Arroz con pollo

story.summary: Maria's family makes Arroz con pollo for Sunday lunch. Her abuela sold it at a market stall in Cali for years and her mum still makes too much of it.
story.full_text: it's what sunday lunch smells like. abuela sold it at a market stall in Cali for years and mum still makes too much of it.
